Work

I care about how it looks and what it does.

I'm Mehboob, a graphic designer based in Srinagar with over two years in the field. Most of my work is for local businesses that sell through Instagram: bakeries, fashion labels, clinics, institutes and travel companies.

Before I open a design file I ask what the post has to do: sell a dessert, fill a batch, build trust in a doctor. Then I keep one idea per frame, a clear hierarchy, and a look your audience recognises the next time they see it.
